title: Lifting a normalized tensor factor along a finite DVR extension
statement: Let $B$ and $A$ be DVR domains [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], with $A$ finite over $B$ [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], and let $E/\operatorname{Frac}(B)$ be finite separable [def-pc-field-extension, def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. Give $E$ its composite $B$-algebra structure. Let $P$ be a maximal ideal of $E\otimes_B A$, let $F=(E\otimes_B A)/P$, and assume the right tensor map $\alpha:A\to F$ is injective. Give $F$ this $A$-algebra structure, and assume $S=\operatorname{integralClosure}_A(F)$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure] is finite over $A$. Let $Q$ be a prime of $S$ contracting to $\mathfrak m_A$. Let $A_1$ be any DVR domain with compatible $B$- and $A$-algebra structures making $B\to A\to A_1$ a tower, and assume $A_1$ is finite and faithful over $A$. There exist a maximal ideal $P_1$ of $E\otimes_B A_1$, its field quotient $F_1=(E\otimes_B A_1)/P_1$ with injective right map $\alpha_1:A_1\to F_1$, and the integral closure $S_1=\operatorname{integralClosure}_{A_1}(F_1)$ finite over $A_1$. With $A\to F_1$ given by composition through $A_1$, there exist an $A$-algebra embedding $i:S\to S_1$ and a prime $Q_1$ of $S_1$ such that $i^{-1}(Q_1)=Q$ and $Q_1\cap A_1=\mathfrak m_{A_1}$. Moreover $S_1$ is flat over $S$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] for the algebra structure induced by $i$.

source.place: Tags 09EM (Remark 15.116.1, normalized tensor factors and surjectivity on spectra), 032L (finite separable normalization), and lying over.

proof.text: Put F=(E tensor_B A)/P. The injective map A -> F and faithful A -> A1 make F tensor_A A1 nonzero (Algebra.TensorProduct.nontrivial_of_algebraMap_injective_of_isDomain). Choose a maximal ideal M and let G=(F tensor_A A1)/M. The map F -> G is injective since F is a field. The kernel of A1 -> G contracts to zero in A; integrality of A1/A and Ideal.eq_bot_of_comap_eq_bot show that A1 -> G is injective.

The maps E -> F -> G and A1 -> G agree on B and give phi:E tensor_B A1 -> G. Prove phi surjective by two tensor inductions: the class of (class of e tensor_B a) tensor_A a1 is the image of e tensor_B (a*a1), and addition and zero are preserved. Let P1=ker(phi); it is maximal because G is a field and phi is surjective. The quotient-kernel equivalence F1=(E tensor_B A1)/P1 -> G commutes with A1, so its inverse restricts the embedding F -> G to an A-algebra embedding f:F -> F1. It also proves injectivity of the right map A1 -> F1.

The B-map into F is injective through Frac(B) and E, hence B -> A and B -> A1 are injective. Finiteness in the tower B -> A -> A1 gives Module.Finite B A1. Apply [lem-sbc-dvr-root-tensor-factor-integral-closure-finite] to P1 to prove finiteness of S1=integralClosure_A1(F1). Restrict f to i:S=integralClosure_A(F) -> S1: integrality maps along f and ascends from A to A1. This restriction is injective.

S1 is finite over A by transitivity, hence integral over S via the compatible A-algebra map i. Apply Ideal.exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral_of_isDomain, using ker(i)=0, to lift Q to Q1. Its contraction to A is m_A, by the equality i^{-1}(Q1)=Q. The prime Q1 cap A1 is maximal since A1/A is integral and its contraction is maximal; locality of A1 therefore identifies it with m_A1.

Finiteness of S over the Noetherian DVR A gives IsNoetherianRing S. The integral closure S is integrally closed in F and embeds into F; IsIntegrallyClosed.of_isIntegrallyClosedIn gives intrinsic normality. Ring.DimensionLEOne.integralClosure supplies dimension at most one, so S is Dedekind. The injective map i into the domain S1 makes S1 torsion free over S (Module.isTorsionFree_iff_algebraMap_injective). Mathlib.RingTheory.Flat.TorsionFree gives Module.Flat S S1.

proof_origin.place: Tags 09EM and 032L; direct maximal quotient of F tensor_A A1, lying over, and torsion-free flatness over a Dedekind domain.

lean.statement:
theorem dvr_normalized_tensor_factor_lift
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B]
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    [Algebra B A] [Module.Finite B A]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (FractionRing B) E]
    (hE : FiniteDimensional (FractionRing B) E ∧ Algebra.IsSeparable (FractionRing B) E) :
    letI : Algebra B E :=
      ((algebraMap (FractionRing B) E).comp (algebraMap B (FractionRing B))).toAlgebra
    ∀ (P : Ideal (E ⊗[B] A)) (hP : P.IsMaximal),
    letI := hP
    let F := (E ⊗[B] A) ⧸ P
    let alpha : A →+* F := (Ideal.Quotient.mk P).comp
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A →ₐ[B] E ⊗[B] A).toRingHom
    letI := alpha.toAlgebra
    Function.Injective alpha →
    let S := integralClosure A F
    Module.Finite A S →
    ∀ (Q : Ideal S) (hQ : Q.IsPrime),
    Q.comap (algebraMap A S) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A →
    ∀ (A₁ : Type u) [CommRing A₁] [IsDomain A₁] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A₁]
      [Algebra A A₁] [Algebra B A₁] [IsScalarTower B A A₁]
      [Module.Finite A A₁] [FaithfulSMul A A₁],
    ∃ (P₁ : Ideal (E ⊗[B] A₁)) (hP₁ : P₁.IsMaximal),
    letI := hP₁
    let F₁ := (E ⊗[B] A₁) ⧸ P₁
    let alpha₁ : A₁ →+* F₁ := (Ideal.Quotient.mk P₁).comp
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A₁ →ₐ[B] E ⊗[B] A₁).toRingHom
    letI := alpha₁.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra A F₁ := (alpha₁.comp (algebraMap A A₁)).toAlgebra
    letI : IsScalarTower A A₁ F₁ := .of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
    let S₁ := integralClosure A₁ F₁
    Function.Injective alpha₁ ∧ Module.Finite A₁ S₁ ∧
    ∃ (i : S →ₐ[A] S₁) (Q₁ : Ideal S₁),
      Q₁.IsPrime ∧ Q₁.comap i.toRingHom = Q ∧
      Q₁.comap (algebraMap A₁ S₁) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A₁ ∧
      letI := i.toRingHom.toAlgebra
      Module.Flat S S₁
